### Holiday Cheer Starts Here: Caesars Entertainment Offers Special Perks for Las Vegas Locals Seven Days a Week


10/27/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) DOCX](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/2026/Oct/27/2026-Locals-Offer-Press-Release-FOR-NEWSROOM.docx)


*From Oct. 31 through Dec. 26, Nevada residents receive complimentary self-parking* *and 25% off food and beverages*


*For more information on the locals offer, guests can visit*[caesars.com/lasvegaslocals](https://www.caesars.com/las-vegas/hotels/deals/locals)


[Download high-res photos and b-roll of Caesars Entertainment’s Las Vegas resorts](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Qmf1pq5aXmN4-3Emw2KKh2Rn1lcgQngL?usp=drive_link)


******


**Key Facts**


From Oct. 31 through Dec. 26, Nevada residents can take advantage of special perks at participating Caesars Entertainment destinations seven days a week, including:


- **Complimentary self-parking** at Caesars Entertainment’s eight Las Vegas resorts, including Miracle Mile Shops at Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino.
- **25% off dining and drink experiences** for Caesars Rewards® members at participating restaurants, bars and lounges.


****


**LAS VEGAS (Oct. 27, 2026)** – Caesars Entertainment is bringing extra holiday cheer to Las Vegas locals with seasonal deals. From Saturday, Oct. 31, through Saturday, Dec. 26, Nevada residents can enjoy **complimentary self-parking** and **save 25% on drink and dining experiences seven days a week, including Thanksgiving and Christmas,** at Caesars Entertainment's eight Las Vegas resorts. A Caesars Rewards® membership is required for the food and beverage discount.


Participating resorts include Caesars Palace, The Vanderpump Hotel, Harrah’s Las Vegas, Flamingo Las Vegas, The LINQ Hotel + Casino, Paris Las Vegas, Horseshoe Las Vegas and Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino (including the Miracle Mile Shops self-parking garage).


“The holiday season is a great time to explore everything Caesars Entertainment has to offer,” said Sean McBurney, Chief Commercial Officer and Regional President of Caesars Entertainment. “Whether it’s a memorable meal at Gordon Ramsay Steak at Paris Las Vegas, cocktails at Gigolo at The Vanderpump Hotel or a relaxing spa day at Qua Baths & Spa at Caesars Palace, we want to make it easier for Nevada residents to enjoy experiences across all eight of our Las Vegas resorts during one of the busiest and most special times of year.”


From casual outings to special celebrations, locals can enjoy savings at a wide selection of participating restaurants, bars and lounges across Caesars Entertainment’s Las Vegas resorts. Guests can fill their plates with seasonal favorites at **Bacchanal Buffet** at Caesars Palace or skip the holiday cooking with a Thanksgiving Meal To-Go from **The Bedford by Martha Stewart** at Paris Las Vegas. **** For those with a sweet tooth, **Dominique Ansel Las Vegas** at Caesars Palace and **Dominique** **Ansel Marché** at Paris Las Vegas offer new fall pastries, Thanksgiving pies and holiday bûche cakes.


In addition to dining and parking, Nevada residents can enjoy 15-20% off select spa and salon treatments, 20-25% off select attractions and exclusive savings on select concerts and shows.


**What's new at Caesars Entertainment's Las Vegas resorts?**


The locals offer is an opportunity for guests to explore some of the newest additions on The Strip:


- **SIPS Drinkery House pop-up** **at VISTA Cocktail Lounge at Caesars Palace** – Starting Saturday, Oct. 31, guests can try signature drinks from the premier Barcelona bar named The World’s Best Bar by The World’s 50 Best Bars in 2023.
- **Track 35 Bar & Lounge at The LINQ Hotel + Casino** – Inspired by New York subway culture, this new bar pairs cocktails with a lively setting on the casino floor right next to Guy Fieri’s Vegas Kitchen & Bar.
- **Le Jardin à Paris at Paris Las Vegas** – Located across from Dominique Ansel Marché, the new smoothie and bowl bar also offers coconut refreshers, wellness shots and other nourishing beverages.


Guests 21+ can enroll in the Caesars Rewards® loyalty program for free at[caesars.com/program](http://www.caesars.com/program) .


To make a reservation or for more information, including participating venues and exclusions, guests can visit[caesars.com/lasvegaslocals](http://caesars.com/lasvegaslocals) .


**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQs)**


**How do guests sign up for Caesars Rewards®?**


Guests 21+ can visit the Caesars Rewards **®** desk at any Caesars Rewards **®** property or visit[caesars.com/program](http://www.caesars.com/program) .


****


**When is the locals offer available?**


Nevada residents can take advantage of these offers from Saturday, Oct. 31, through Saturday, Dec. 26, including Thanksgiving and Christmas.


**Where is complimentary self-parking available?**


Nevada residents will have access to complimentary self-parking at Caesars Entertainment’s Las Vegas resorts, including Caesars Palace, The Vanderpump Hotel, Harrah’s Las Vegas, Flamingo Las Vegas, The LINQ Hotel + Casino, Paris Las Vegas, Horseshoe Las Vegas and the Miracle Mile Shops/Planet Hollywood garage.


**How can Nevada residents take advantage of complimentary self-parking?**


Guests must scan a valid Nevada ID at participating garages for complimentary self-parking. For self-parking at Miracle Mile Shops/Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino, guests must pick up a parking validation sticker from the valet office on the ground floor of the parking garage.


**Is there a time limit on complimentary self-parking?**


Complimentary self-parking is available seven days a week for Nevada residents who present a valid Nevada ID, including Thanksgiving and Christmas. There is no time limit on parking.


**How do guests redeem the food and beverage discount?**


Nevada residents must present a valid Nevada ID and their Caesars Rewards® membership card at the time of purchase to save 25% on eligible food and beverage purchases.


**Is the food and beverage discount available during the FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX?**


Nevada residents who are Caesars Rewards® members can still receive 25% off food and beverage purchases at a wide variety of participating restaurants, bars and lounges across Caesars Entertainment's Las Vegas resorts during the FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX. The discount is not valid for special F1 dining experiences from Thursday, Nov. 19, through Saturday, Nov. 21. For more information about F1 dining experiences, guests can visit[caesars.com/events/f1](https://www.caesars.com/events/f1) .


**What drink and dining experiences are eligible for the locals offer?**


Nevada residents who are Caesars Rewards® members can receive 25% off eligible dine-in and to-go orders. Eligible to-go purchases include seasonal pies from Dominique Ansel Las Vegas at Caesars Palace and Dominique Ansel Marché at Paris Las Vegas, as well as the Thanksgiving To-Go Meal from The Bedford by Martha Stewart at Paris Las Vegas. Caesars Eats pick-up or delivery orders are not included.


****


**Where is the food and beverage discount available?**


The 25% discount is available to Nevada residents who are Caesars Rewards® members at participating restaurants, bars and lounges. For the current list of participating venues, guests can visit[caesars.com/lasvegaslocals](https://www.caesars.com/las-vegas/hotels/deals/locals) .


**Which attractions are included in the locals offer?**


Nevada residents receive 20-25% off select attractions, including the High Roller Observation Wheel, Fly LINQ Zipline and the Eiffel Tower Viewing Deck. To view a list of participating attractions, guests can visit[caesars.com/lasvegaslocals](https://www.caesars.com/las-vegas/hotels/deals/locals) .


**Which shows and venues are included in the locals offer?**


Guests can enjoy exclusive savings on select concerts and shows. For the current list of participating venues, guests can visit[caesars.com/lasvegaslocals](https://www.caesars.com/las-vegas/hotels/deals/locals) .


**Which spas and salons are included in the locals offer?**


Nevada residents receive 15-20% off select spa and salon experiences at The Spa at Flamingo Las Vegas, The Spa at The LINQ Hotel + Casino, The Spa at Harrah’s Las Vegas, Voie Spa & Salon at Paris Las Vegas, Reflections the Spa at Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino and Qua Baths & Spa at Caesars Palace. The offer at Qua Baths & Spa is available Monday through Thursday.


**About Caesars Entertainment, Inc.**


Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR) is the largest casino entertainment company in the U.S. and one of the world's most diversified casino entertainment providers. Since its beginning in Reno, NV, in 1937, Caesars Entertainment, Inc. has grown through the development of new resorts, expansions and acquisitions. Caesars Entertainment, Inc.'s resorts operate primarily under the Caesars®, Harrah's®, Horseshoe® and Eldorado® brand names. Caesars Entertainment, Inc. offers diversified gaming, entertainment and hospitality amenities, one-of-a-kind destinations and a full suite of mobile and online gaming and sports betting experiences. All tied to its industry-leading Caesars Rewards® loyalty program, the company focuses on building value with its guests through a unique combination of impeccable service, operational excellence and technology leadership.
